question: Does governance add investment information within PBR after considering size and PIT ROE?

dividend.primary: Original price-path beginning-of-month weights frozen; substitute FnGuide returns. Complete result only when every held return matches; otherwise matched-weight conditional moments, no NAV or full-portfolio label.
dividend.secondary: If complete: same original formation and budgets, drift weights using FnGuide returns; no new rebalancing or window extension.

matching.method: Outcome-blind greedy one-to-one without replacement; sort all admissible edges by sum of squared normalized covariate distances then stock identifiers for ties.
matching.missing_roe: exclude from both eligible-before and matched-after samples, disclose attrition
matching.outcomes: 58 same calendar months, equal mean across monthly observed price-return differences; matched monthly difference uses only pairs with both returns observed. Before sample is PIT-ROE-eligible firms on the identical calendar months. No compounded NAV, p-values or causal inference.
matching.balance: By-cohort aggregate means, medians and standardized mean differences; report coverage and residual imbalance. Fixed calipers will not be retuned.

daily_audit: Original 11 unique first-held-gap events and extreme filters only; inspect original and adjusted month-end levels and adjustment factors. No imputation or repair without economic payoff evidence.
factor_file: Schema and units inspected only; no factor/FF3 outcome used.
publication: Aggregates and hashes only; no FnGuide securities, raw sheets, daily levels, financial observations or keys.
